description: The full binary-word tree is perfect, and its paths are exactly the natural-number sequences taking only the values zero and one.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.binaryTree_spec :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.IsPerfect Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.binaryTree ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.body Lemmatheca.Entry.PerfectSubtrees.binaryTree =
      {x | ∀ (n : ℕ), x n = 0 ∨ x n = 1}
